chunks: 2265 - And he, peace be upon him, said:
"Hasten to greet the hajj pilgrims and those performing 'umrah, and to shake their hands, before sins mingle with them."

key_terms.الْحَاجِّ: the one performing hajj; the pilgrim
key_terms.بَادِرُوا: hasten; take the initiative without delay
key_terms.بِالسَّلَامِ: with greeting of peace; offering salām
key_terms.مُصَافَحَتِهِمْ: shaking their hands; greeting them by handshake

ai.seo_question: Why should one quickly greet and shake hands with hajj pilgrims and those returning from 'umrah?
ai.summary: The Imam عليه السلام encourages promptly greeting and shaking hands with those returning from hajj and 'umrah. The hadith highlights the spiritual purity and honor associated with these acts of worship, urging believers to meet the pilgrims before they become re-engaged with ordinary human sin.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "Hasten to greet the pilgrims and those performing Umrah and to shake their hands before sins mingle with them."
